root_causes.summary: The model overrode the tool working directory with a copied absolute Windows path; a backslash-b segment was decoded as a backspace and CreateProcessAsUserW returned error 267.
The direct py fallback embedded escaped newlines in python -c source, so Python received literal continuation characters and raised SyntaxError.
The live Constrained Language message 'Cannot create type. Only core types are supported' was not included in the restricted-PowerShell classifier.

rules: Do not set or override the EvalOps shell tool working directory.
Use relative paths with forward slashes inside tool arguments.
Use only a single physical shell-safe line for direct py -c fallback.
Do not pass multiline source, escaped newline sequences, or a PowerShell here-string to py -c.

tests_cover: EvalOps prompt forbids explicit cwd override
EvalOps prompt requires relative forward-slash paths
shared fallback prompt forbids multiline py -c
CreateProcessAsUserW error 267 plus escaped cwd gets a specific code
live restricted-language and multiline-fallback event shape normalizes with an explicit exhaustion diagnostic
